description.value: Nordstrom NYC Flagship sits in Central Park Tower on West 57th Street. Wikipedia notes that the basement and first five above-ground stories contain a large Nordstrom store, which opened in 2019, and that The entrance for Nordstrom is on 57th Street. It adds that The Nordstrom location has an open plan for its floors, and Each level has 19-foot (5.8 m) ceilings. The store is near Carnegie Hall and Columbus Circle for a combined shopping walk. An aggregated guest-review listing for the 57th Street flagship shows Rating 4.4 out of 5 · 1,761 reviews. Representative aggregated guest reviews praise (aggregated guest reviews): “The store has a beautiful, modern design”. Representative watch-outs: “The selection is a bit smaller compared to some other department stores”.
